system.description:
When you deal damage to a hostile creature that is Corroded or Burned you can spend 2 Pressure.

When you do, you convert Corroded into ranks of Scald equal to the rank of Corroded they currently have, as they lose the Corroded condition. (D-Rank: 1 Rank, C-Rank: 2 Ranks, B-Rank: 3 Ranks, A-Rank: 4 Ranks, S-Rank: 5 Ranks)

Alternatively, you convert an equal number of Burned into Scald.
